notes.title: Netspectre at GameAccess '25
notes.content: We will be at GameAccess in Brno on the 6-7th June with the latest Netspectre build, so come say hi if you'll be there and give it a go! And if you're still considering whether to attend, definitely do; GameAccess is always great and we can wholeheartedly recommend it. See you there!

notes.title: Netspectre at GDS '24 Indie Expo
notes.content: We will be with Netspectre at the Indie Expo of the Game Developers Session this Friday and Saturday, 13-14th December 2024, in Prague, so come play Netspectre with us and let us know what you think!

notes.title: Come play Netspectre to the GDS' 23 this weekend
notes.content:
We'll be making camp at the Indie Expo section of the Game Developers Session '23 that's taking place in Prague this Friday and Saturday! You'll be able to play the latest build and we're super curious what you think about it. And if you like what you see, we've got playtester Steam keys to give out, so that you can play more Netspectre even when you come back home. See you there!

notes.title: Netspectre at GameAccess '23
notes.content:
This year's GameAccess in Brno is happening this week and we'll be there with Netspectre! We'll have a brand new build for you to play if you'll be around, so come say hi and check it out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42329567/dfbaa6e0355709e130099fc288814eddd8e5fff0.png[/img]
We'll be at the Indie Showcase zone all Friday and Saturday, i.e. the 2nd and 3rd June 2023. We have a lot of major updates freshly released for this build, such as a new UI or a new soundtrack, that we're curious what you think about. See you there!
